title: Travelling abroad with the World's Greatest Jazz Band
summary: She went to Europe nearly every year with the band; her earlier trips were Britain in 1948 and 1953-54.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Do you know the last time I saw you in concert was at Town Hall a few years ago.
Yeah, well that's been a long time, man. That's been a long, long time. These were taken in Stockholm.
How many times have you been around the world, Max?
I haven't been around the world --
How many times have you been in Europe?
Well, in the last few years I was travelling with the World's Greatest Jazz Band
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
and we were going over just about every year.
They were at the Jazz Festival this year.
As a matter of fact you haven't actually travelled that much, have you? You said in '48 and '53, '54 you went to Great Britain.
That's right, I didn't go on the Continent -- the first time I went on the Continent --
